This site is the CDEG–A team's report for the NexStar 2026 Melbourne–Chengdu Sprint. It has three parts:

- **[Part A: Business models](part-a/index.qmd).** How each business line makes money in Australia, who the major players are, and what things cost, compared with China.
- **[Part B: Compliance](part-b/index.qmd).** The permits, licences and approvals each business line needs, the shortcuts, and who has done it before. Every step links to the official source.
- **[Models](models/index.qmd).** Interactive models: change inflation, unit costs, prices or investment rounds and see when a project pays back.

::: {.placeholder}
- Executive summary: 5–6 key findings and the recommended entry route
- One-line answer for CDEG: where to start, with whom, and why
:::

- **[第二部分：合规](part-b/index.qmd)**：各业务所需的许可、执照和审批，可用的捷径，以及谁有相关经验。每一步都附官方链接。
